copane.vscodeChat.serverDefinition.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Also offer the `copane` MCP server to VS Code's own chat and agent mode (GitHub Copilot chat) as a server this extension provides, which always connects to *this* window, instead of guessing the window from the working directory. Not yet verified with a signed-in Copilot. Together with the `mcp-config.json` entry (`#copane.registration.copilot#`), a Copilot chat session may list Copane twice or use the other entry; if it does, turn off one of the two: this setting, or the `mcp-config.json` entry with `copilot mcp disable copane` (which also turns Copane off for the Copilot CLI) and `#copane.registration.copilot#` off.
